construction: 26 parts in 7 steps. Steps 1–2: two 1×2–2×2 brackets and a 2×2 tan brick. Step 3: two down brackets. Step 4: eight 1×2 jumper plates on the four faces. Step 5: eight 1×2 clip plates. Steps 6–7: four more jumper plates and a 2×2 brick.
interfaces: Stud directions: 26 parts, 6 up and exactly 5 per horizontal direction. All eight clip centres fall inside `48336` handle plates of the eight `21309 - 103-107.ldr` panels.
lesson: A radial hub of jumper and clip plates on four faces carries eight skin panels by their handles.
parent_context: The hub at the centre of the rocket body, level with a band of vertical ribbed panels, in `21309 - main.ldr` (identity matrix).
reuse_notes: Use it for round bodies that need a skin of identical panels: two panels per face, splayed.
